title: Rolling Pin Swords
description: All swords are now rolling pins.
body:
Why fight with boring swords when you can destroy your enemies with a rolling pin?

![Rolling pins on the shelf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9borRsMx/images/b970878999fefd3f812e7c75349813dbe8431741.png)

This resource pack replaces all vanilla swords with detailed rolling pins.
Each material tier has small visual patterns so you can quickly recognize which one you’re holding.

- Custom models
- Unique tier patterns
- Vanilla-friendly style

Bake. Bonk. Repeat.
